title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill x2 Blackcurrant Berry 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Doozy’s Seriously Pod Fill x2 Blackcurrant Berry is a bold and juicy blend that brings together the deep, tangy notes of Blackcurrant with a medley of mixed Berries for a richly-layered and satisfying vape. The Blackcurrant provides a deep, jammy sweetness combined with a hint of tartness, while the bright, juicy Berries add sweet, summery notes for balance. This carefully crafted combination delivers a delightfully well-rounded and full-bodied flavour with every puff. With a 50% VG / 50% PG formulation and double-concentrated flavour, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth, yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Doozy is a leading UK e-liquid brand known for its diverse flavour profiles and high-quality formulations. The Seriously Pod Fill x2 range is specially crafted for MTL vapers, offering full flavour with a refined throat hit in a versatile 50/50 blend.
